name: mozilla/notes
why: Official Mozilla project explicitly tagged abandoned/unmaintained by its own maintainers - a clean example of a corporate-sponsored tool retired rather than open-sourced-and-forgotten organically.

name: sorentwo/readthis
description: Pooled active support compliant caching with redis
why: A small, focused caching library with a permissive license and no successor project - exactly the kind of narrowly useful utility the seed describes as useful but never finished.

name: danimahardhika/candybar-library
why: Still-starred Android UI library abandoned mid ecosystem-shift; permissively licensed and specific enough to be a reusable shape rather than a toy.

name: kanjielu/jeeves
why: Chat-bot framework tied to a single messaging platform's API - a common failure mode (platform-coupled tools) worth studying as a pattern, not just an artifact.

name: jacobian/django-deployment-workshop
description: Code and configuration used in my Django Deployment Workshop.
why: Literally a workshop repo (teaching material, not a product) - included as a direct thematic anchor for this project's own name and seed.
